## Letters

It starts with letters. Each of the twenty-two below: its old picture, the meaning of its name, its value, its place in Sefer Yetzirah, the Greek and Latin letters it became, the letters it is easily taken for, and a note.
{% for l in site.data.letters %}
### {{ l[1].char }}{% if l[1].final %} {{ l[1].final }}{% endif %} {{ l[1].name }} ({{ l[1].name_heb }}) [{{ l[0] }}]
picture: {{ l[1].picture }} · meaning: {{ l[1].meaning }} · value: {{ l[1].value }} · Sefer Yetzirah: {{ l[1].sefer_yetzirah }} · Greek: {{ l[1].greek }}{% if l[1].latin %} · Latin: {{ l[1].latin }}{% endif %}
{% for n in l[1].near %}near {{ n.char }}: {{ n.note }}
{% endfor %}{{ l[1].note | strip }}
{% endfor %}

## Names

Each leaf below: name, native form [id], meaning; then its parent and how it is joined, the verse, its roots, and its note. Roots are Hebrew consonants; יה is Yah and אל is El. Identity links carry a certainty when the sameness is uncertain.
{% for g in site.data.groves %}
